component.name: Kiwi
component.summary: Privacy-first web browser powered by the Mustela engine

description.p: Kiwi is a small privacy-first browser built on the Mustela engine (WebKitGTK): tracking domains are refused through a local proxy with DoH, fingerprint surfaces are switches instead of promises, and every site can carry its own rules for JavaScript, cookies, fingerprinting, permissions and dressing.
The interface is a deliberate Material Design 3 pastel-peach theme: solid fills, 1px outlines, no gradients, no shadows, no blur.

Identity and platform dressing: full hicolor icon set, project website, page saving as MHTML (Ctrl+S), HTML5 element fullscreen and web notifications surfaced through the engine view API, F11 window fullscreen.
Check-for-updates button in Settings — on-demand check against GitHub Releases with a platform asset picker and download progress; packaging: deb and Flatpak bundles attached to the release channel.
View slice 2 UI: find bar, MD3 context menu, devtools toggle.
Bookmarks manager, search engines editor with !keyword shortcuts, profile manager.
Privacy center: per-site override editor with a live toolbar indicator and stored-data management screens.
